'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Nick Reisch DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
